description: Get device logcat output. Use to find crashes, exceptions, and errors after reproducing a bug.

device_id.description: Device ID (optional if only one device)

level.description: Minimum log level: V(erbose), D(ebug), I(nfo), W(arn), E(rror), F(atal)

lines.description: Number of recent log lines to return (default 200)

package_name.description: Filter logs by app package name (e.g., com.example.app)

name: get_logs
